**DK27.6** is a medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastroduodenal ulcer accompanied by both bleeding and perforation [^src1]. Within the context of the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring, this specific code plays a critical role in tracking severe gastrointestinal complications among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1].

The code is utilized as part of a comprehensive set of diagnostic criteria to measure the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|Alvorlig blødning]] in the national Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) [^src3]. Because patients with atrial fibrillation are frequently prescribed anticoagulant medications, monitoring bleeding events is a key quality indicator for patient safety [^src2]. To capture these events accurately, the AFDK methodology employs a broad spectrum of ICD-10 codes spanning multiple organ systems. For instance, alongside intracranial bleeding codes (such as [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and other gastrointestinal codes (like [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]]), DK27.6 is specifically designated to identify severe gastrointestinal bleeding events resulting from ulcer complications [^src1].

This diagnostic code appears consistently across multiple annual methodology reports for the AFDK, including the 2023, 2024, and 2025 publications by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. Its persistent inclusion underscores its importance as a standardized metric for evaluating the risks associated with atrial fibrillation treatments and for benchmarking clinical outcomes across Danish regions [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
